symptom: `use building block Atlas_Web_Content.Master_Detail as md_` fails exec with `failed to build page: failed to build datasource: widget not found: gallery2` — the widgets became md_gallery2 / md_dataView7 but the data view's `selection gallery2` kept the old name; without a prefix the same block builds
cause: prefixWidgetNames renamed WidgetV3.Name only. A block's widgets reference each other by name in property values, and those were never visited
insight: A rename is a rename of declarations AND references in one pass — the same rule as $ID renumbering. Widget names are referenced in two spellings: bare (selection Reference, association ContextVariable, `delete $w` SourceVariable, LinkVariable — listed by type because Reference means an entity or flow for other source types) and as a `$name` token in any text (flow args, `$dv.Attr` template params, visibility/editability expressions, where clauses). Rewrite the token form generically by reflecting over every property value rather than enumerating property keys, restricted to names DECLARED in the block so outside references survive. Rewrite copy-on-write: cloneWidget copies the property map, not the values, so mutating a *DataSourceV3 in place corrupts the fragment definition for its next `use`. Measured on 11.14.0: prefixed Master_Detail now gives exactly the mx check errors the unprefixed one does (CE0488/CE3637 from the unbound template gallery); with `(datasource: database from E)` those clear and only the template's unbound text boxes (CE7005) remain. Tests `use_building_block_prefix_refs_560_test.go`; control = pre-fix run, selection reference stayed `listView2`
